reasoning_steps: 1. The wavelength of the optical source is lambda = 800 nm = 800 x 10^-9 m.
2. The frequency of the optical source is f = c / lambda = 3 x 10^8 / (800 x 10^-9) = 3.75 x 10^14 Hz.
3. The available channel bandwidth is 1% of the source frequency = 0.01 * 3.75 x 10^14 = 3.75 x 10^12 Hz.
4. The bandwidth required for one audio channel is 8 kHz = 8000 Hz.
5. Number of channels = (Available channel bandwidth) / (Bandwidth per channel) = (3.75 x 10^12) / 8000.
assumptions_used: No guard bands are required between channels.
Speed of light in the communication medium is approx 3 x 10^8 m/s.
